mil7.5.3:1.1: ‘‘Bhante nāgasena, ‘undūrassa ekaṃ aṅgaṃ gahetabba’nti yaṃ vadesi, katamaṃ taṃ ekaṃ aṅgaṃ gahetabba’’nti?
mil7.5.3:1.2: ‘‘Yathā, mahārāja, undūro itocito ca vicaranto āhārūpāsīsako yeva carati,
mil7.5.3:1.3: evameva kho, mahārāja, yoginā yogāvacarena itocito ca vicarantena yoniso manasikārūpāsīsakeneva bhavitabbaṃ.
mil7.5.3:1.4: Idaṃ, mahārāja, undūrassa ekaṃ aṅgaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
